summary: Managed nodes need Python; only raw works without it, so bootstrap BSD by installing Python with raw, such as pkg install -y python on FreeBSD or pkg_add -I python%3.11 on OpenBSD.
questions: How do I install Python on FreeBSD with Ansible?
How do I bootstrap an OpenBSD host for Ansible?
Which module works without Python on the target?

answer_card.title: Bootstrap Python on BSD
answer_card.answer_md:
Only the `raw` module works without Python, so use it to install Python:
```bash
ansible -m raw -a "pkg install -y python" myfreebsdhost          # FreeBSD
ansible -m raw -a "pkg_add -I python%3.11" myopenbsdhost       # OpenBSD
```
Use your BSD's package tool and package name if different. After that, other modules work.
